title: Sublimity
physical_identity: Submerged ceramic-tile complex of pools and halls; lukewarm blue-green water with constant ripple; irregular lights and dark corners.
scale_topology: Immense; whether infinite is not stated; indoor-pool architecture; stairs descend into deep pits.
anomalies: Epsom-salt water with unknown enhancing compounds
lighting_sound: Light from irregular angles with dark areas; sound muffled, dry, water sound variable.

entrances.conditions: may lead to reemerging in Level 37
entrances.quote: Submerging oneself in the waters of Level 58 and Level 119 may lead to one reemerging in this level
Submerging oneself in the waters of Level 58 and Level 119 may lead to one reemerging in this level
Porcelain-tiled areas of Level 233 infrequently lead to this level
In rare circumstances, underwater areas of level-130 may act as entrances to this level
You can also enter via an arcade on Level 25

exits.quote: Immersing oneself in the water of Level 37 may cause reemergence in the pools of Level 130
Enclosed, dark tunnels in this level may lead to Level 43
Corridors in Level 37 can rarely lead to similar corridors in Level 233

signature_mechanic: Relaxing Epsom-salt water and altered acoustics in an empty pristine tile maze; exits by immersion or dark tunnels.
verticality: Stairs that descend into deep water pits; no other vertical structure stated.
